text:
Priya: Quick question @everyone — if one song had to play every time you walked into any meeting for the rest of your life, what would it be? Keep it dumb and fun :grin:
Tom: Eye of the Tiger :muscle: easy win
Jules: Can't Touch This — instant mood setter :sunglasses:
Asha: Also sprach Zarathustra (2001 theme) for dramatic flair
Li: Silent entrance. just silence. 0/10 on the kazoo economy :shushing_face:
Marcus: Sirius (Alan Parsons Project) — stadium vibes without the sweat
Tom: If we can pick two: 'Start Me Up' for morning syncs and 'Solsbury Hill' for post-lunch recovery
Priya: Love the variety. vote by emoji? :thumbsup: for Eye of the Tiger, :heart: for Can't Touch This, :clap: for 2001 theme
Jules: :heart: — originality points
Asha: :clap: — classical nerd victory
Li: :thumbsup: (silence wins the quiet minority)
Marcus: also acceptable: instrumental lo-fi hip hop loop for focus
Priya: Noted. We have chaos, classical, silence, and lo-fi. This is a very Redwood distribution of tastes :laughing:
LunchBot: Friendly reminder: whatever theme you pick, lunch is served in the kitchen at 12:30 today — tacos. :taco:
Tom: Tacos > meeting theme tbh :stuck_out_tongue:
Priya: Poll takeaway: if forced to pick one, consensus seems split. Thread verdict: keep the memes, keep the tacos, and maybe rotate themes each week? :party_parrot:
Jules: weekly themes would be peak morale
Marcus: Agree. Also, someone actually add Eye of the Tiger to the meeting playlist so I can ghost into a 1:1 dramatically
Li: Do not actually. My productivity cannot handle that level of hype
Priya: Okay team — new initiative: "Entrance Themes, low commitment edition". Thanks for the picks :raised_hands:
Tom: will add sticky note to the playlist channel :thumbsup:
Jules: yasss
Priya: thread closed, unless someone wants to defend their 80s bop :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
